name: Kami War
description: The war between kami and humans on Kamigawa.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The town of Reito is destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

citation.text: Ghostly Prison (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spirits of weapons turn against great warriors in the first days of the war.
timeline.quote: Many great warriors died in the first days of the war

citation.text: Kabuto Moth (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lord Takeshi Konda steals O-Kagachi's heart in 3207 AR, enraging it and starting the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Lord Takeshi Konda stole the great kami's "heart" and a portion of its power

citation.text: "God", section "O-Kagachi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The theft of O-Kagachi's scion starts the Kami War.
timeline.quote: It was because the theft of O-Kagachi's scion, that the Kami War began.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damage from the Apocalypse Chime weakens the veil, letting Konda pull an aspect of O-Kagachi through it and begin the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Enraged, O-Kagachi moves the other kami to strike the mortal world, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus the Kami War began

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Kami War the o-bakemono free many oni masters hoping to destroy Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: the o-bakemono succeeded in freeing many of their oni masters from their spiritual prisons

citation.text: "Ogre", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo; Pipe argues for non-interference.
timeline.quote: Pipe argued for non-interference

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War the orochi refuse to take up arms against the nature spirits and let themselves be slaughtered.
timeline.quote: At first, they refused to take up arms against the nature spirits they worshipped, letting themselves be slaughtered instead.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, tries to honor his commitments as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa and a spirit beast threatens the world.
timeline.quote: But as the Kami War threatens to engulf Kamigawa , an unimaginably powerful spirit beast threatens the world.

citation.text: "Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strain on the veil begins to show near the end of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War.

citation.text: Aether Shockwave (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil; the war ends.
timeline.quote: The war ended soon after the Serpent's defeat

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At O-Kagachi's behest the Kami War begins to regain That Which Was Taken.
timeline.quote: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

citation.text: O-Kagachi, Vengeful Kami (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko Konda bonds with Kyodai, ending the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

citation.text: Portrait of Michiko (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reki describes Toshiro as hero of the Kami War or a selfish thief.
timeline.quote: Some called him the hero of the Kami War, others a selfish thief.

citation.text: Memory of Toshiro (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The dark myojin's gifts help end the Kami War.
timeline.quote: The dark myojin's gifts were instrumental in ending the Kami War.

citation.text: Animus of Night's Reach (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The first Imperials subdue the clans over decades after the Kami War.
timeline.quote: In the wake of the Kami War, Kamigawa descended into a state of constant warfare.

citation.text: Nameless Conqueror (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai was established about 1,200 years after the Kami War.
timeline.quote: the Order of Jukai was established to preserve nature and reverence for the spirits.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "The Order of Jukai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo.
timeline.quote: the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years

citation.text: "Dew", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged kami attack the physical world and mortals fight back in a losing battle.
timeline.quote: The kami began to attack the physical world to reclaim

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kami set upon the town of Reito, killing nearly every living thing, and the Kami War begins.
timeline.quote: A few miles from Eiganjo Castle, the kami set upon the town of Reito.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The five kirin kami meet and debate whether to intervene in the Kami War.
timeline.quote: they discussed whether or not they should intervene in the ongoing Kami War

citation.text: "Kirin", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeno leads forces down Eiganjo Hill against the kami in the early days of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Takeno would lead his forces down Eiganjo Hill every third morning

citation.text: "Munetsugu Takeno", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamigawa's denizens pray to the Myojin at the start of the Kami War, but the Myojin, in chaos over Konda's crime, turn against the material world like the other kami.
timeline.quote: like all other kami, the Myojin turned against the material world

citation.text: "Myojin", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda's crime triggered the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Konda's crime triggered the Kami War

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "Konda's Crime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
